author: smuzaffar
body:
Move the [global package dependency in RecoHGCal/TICL/plugins/BuildFile.xml](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/RecoHGCal/TICL/plugins/BuildFile.xml#L1-L39) in to `RecoHGCalTICLPlugins` plugin section. This should fix the SCRAM warnings
```
***WARNING: Multiple usage of "CondFormats/HGCalObjects". Please cleanup "use" in "export" section of "src/RecoHGCal/TICL/plugins/BuildFile.xml"
***WARNING: Multiple usage of "Geometry/CaloGeometry". Please cleanup "use" in "export" section of "src/RecoHGCal/TICL/plugins/BuildFile.xml"

```
title: [TICL] Cleanup plugins/BuildFile.xml to fix scram duplicate dependency warning
